messages:
emma_cs: Heads up — Helios Systems says the contract promo credit (sales-issued) didn’t apply to their latest invoice. Customer is seeing full charge for reserved capacity. Can someone triage?

devon_sales: Which PO/contract? I issued a credit memo last week but didn’t see it hit billing yet.

emma_cs: PO: PO-67321, Contract ID: C-HELIOS-22. Sales note had `PROMO-HEL-2026` in the PO note field. Customer attached the PO to the support ticket.

rachel_billing: Looking in ledger now. Quick check: run against billing db to confirm any matching credit entries.

kevin_engineer: I pulled the invoice webhook logs. The invoice webhook returned 200, but payload shows credits: [] for that order. Attaching snippet:```json
{"order_id":"PO-67321","po_note":"PROMO-HEL-2026","credits":[],"invoice_id":"INV-99011"}
```

rachel_billing: Running DB query: `SELECT * FROM credits WHERE order_id='PO-67321' OR po_note='PROMO-HEL-2026';` Result: 0 rows. Looks like credit was never persisted for that PO.

billing-bot: :info: Payment pipeline alert — credit application failed for order PO-67321 (reason: no matching credit record). Ticket #BILL-5421 created.

devon_sales: I definitely created an internal memo for this customer — maybe it didn’t get the correct PO mapping when Sales sent the grant request. I’ll dig into my thread. Can someone confirm the exact amount to grant so I can re-authorize?

emma_cs: The original credit amount per the contract addendum is $18,000 for the quarter (applied pro-rata across reserved capacity invoices). Customer wants the current invoice corrected immediately.

kevin_engineer: Repro steps I used: 1) simulate invoice generation for order_id PO-67321 2) check credit join on `credits.order_id` 3) invoice emits credits array from ledger service. In our staging repro the credit creation API returned 201, but in prod I see the sales-created memo didn’t POST to /internal/credits (no HTTP call recorded).

rachel_billing: Action plan: Finance can do a manual ledger adjustment + reissue invoice. Need: confirmed credit memo id (or Sales sign-off) and GL code. Also will need the timestamp to tie to the same billing cycle.

devon_sales: I found my thread — looks like I saved the memo as an attachment and never clicked "Send to Billing" (facepalm). I’ll attach the memo now and authorize. Please wait for my sign-off.

emma_cs: Attaching customer ticket and PO. I’ll mark this as P1 for CS. Customer is already pushing back.

rachel_billing: If Sales signs off now we can do manual grant using GL code: 6101-credits. Please confirm amount and who approves.

devon_sales: Approving: confirmed $18,000, approved by devon_sales. Please proceed with manual adjustment and reissue invoice.

kevin_engineer: For audit/automation — we should add a check in the sales-to-billing handler to validate every sales memo has `order_id` and `po_note` mapped before it’s marked "sent". I’ll open an infra ticket.

rachel_billing: Manual entry done: CREDIT-2026-HELIOS created for $18,000, GL 6101-credits, reference PO-67321, applied to INV-99011. Reissued invoice INV-99011-v2 and emailed to customer.

emma_cs: Customer notified and very relieved. They confirmed receipt of corrected invoice. :white_check_mark:

devon_sales: Sorry about the extra churn — adding a checklist item to my sales close flow.

kevin_engineer: Jira INC-4317 opened to add a guard in the sales UI and webhook logs improved.

rachel_billing: Closing billing ticket #BILL-5421. Leave open if anything else crops up.

emma_cs: Thanks all — filing a short postmortem for process gap and tagging finance + sales.
